P3400.title: Cylinder Deactivation System Bank 1
P3400.description: The engine control module has detected a fault in the cylinder deactivation system on bank 1. Variable displacement engines shut off cylinders under low load to save fuel — a fault here disables the function.

causes.label: Deactivation solenoid or oil control valve failed

P3401.title: Cylinder 1 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit Open
P3401.description: The engine control module has detected an open circuit at the cylinder 1 deactivation or intake valve control solenoid. Without a valid circuit, cylinder 1 cannot be deactivated.

causes.label: Pin pushed back out of connector body

P3402.title: Cylinder 1 Deactivation Performance/Stuck Off
P3402.description: The engine control module has detected that cylinder 1 remains deactivated when activation is commanded — the cylinder does not contribute to combustion when expected.

causes.label: Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement

P3403.title: Cylinder 1 Deactivation Stuck On
P3403.description: The engine control module has detected that cylinder 1 remains deactivated when activation is commanded — the deactivation hardware is stuck in the off state. Symptoms include rough running and reduced power.

causes.label: Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement

P3404.title: Cylinder 1 Deactivation Circuit Low Voltage
P3404.description: The engine control module has detected low voltage or a short to ground in the cylinder 1 deactivation control circuit.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P3405.title: Cylinder 1 Deactivation Circuit High Voltage
P3405.description: The engine control module has detected high voltage or a short to power in the cylinder 1 deactivation control circuit.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P3406.title: Cylinder 1 Deactivation Stuck Off
P3406.description: The engine control module has detected that cylinder 1 deactivation hardware is stuck in the off state. The deactivation cannot be released when full-cylinder operation is commanded.

causes.label: Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement

P3407.title: Cylinder 1 Deactivation Stuck On
P3407.description: The engine control module has detected that cylinder 1 deactivation hardware is stuck in the active state. Cylinder 1 stays deactivated when full-cylinder operation is commanded.

causes.label: Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement

P3408.title: Cylinder 1 Deactivation Circuit Low Voltage
P3408.description: The engine control module has detected low voltage on the cylinder 1 deactivation control circuit. Variant of P3404 reported on platforms with separate diagnostic ranges.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P3409.title: Cylinder 1 Deactivation Circuit High Voltage
P3409.description: The engine control module has detected high voltage on the cylinder 1 deactivation control circuit. Variant of P3405 reported on platforms with separate diagnostic ranges.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P340A.title: Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit Bank 1
P340A.description: Generic electrical fault on the cylinder deactivation/intake valve control circuit on bank 1. The mechanism that switches off intake valves on selected cylinders cannot be commanded.

P340B.title: Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit Bank 2
P340B.description: Generic electrical fault on the cylinder deactivation/intake valve control circuit on bank 2.

P340C.title: Deactivation/Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Bank 1
P340C.description: Generic electrical fault on the cylinder deactivation/exhaust valve control circuit on bank 1. The exhaust control valve modulates exhaust backpressure or routing (EGR feed, sound, regen support); a malfunction shifts torque mapping and may trigger limp mode.

P340D.title: Deactivation/Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Bank 2
P340D.description: Generic electrical fault on the cylinder deactivation/exhaust valve control circuit on bank 2. The exhaust control valve modulates exhaust backpressure or routing (EGR feed, sound, regen support); a malfunction shifts torque mapping and may trigger limp mode.

P3410.title: Cylinder Deactivation System Bank 2
P3410.description: The engine control module has detected a fault in the cylinder deactivation system on bank 2. The system disables fuel and valve operation on selected cylinders under low load to reduce fuel consumption; a fault disables further deactivation requests on this bank.

causes.label: Deactivation solenoid or oil control valve failed

P3411.title: Cylinder 2 Deactivation Performance
P3411.description: The engine control module has detected that cylinder 2 deactivation does not perform as expected — the actual cylinder behavior does not match the commanded state.

P3412.title: Cylinder 2 Deactivation Stuck Off
P3412.description: The engine control module has detected that cylinder 2 deactivation hardware is stuck in the off state. The deactivation cannot be released when full-cylinder operation is commanded.

causes.label: Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement

P3413.title: Cylinder 2 Deactivation Stuck On
P3413.description: The engine control module has detected that cylinder 2 deactivation hardware is stuck in the active state. Cylinder 2 stays deactivated when full-cylinder operation is commanded.

causes.label: Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement

P3414.title: Cylinder 2 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit/Open
P3414.description: The engine control module has detected an open or out-of-range circuit at the cylinder 2 exhaust valve deactivation solenoid. Without a valid circuit the exhaust valve of cylinder 2 cannot be commanded for cylinder deactivation.

causes.label: Pin pushed back out of connector body

P3415.title: Cylinder 2 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Low
P3415.description: The engine control module has detected a low-side voltage fault (short to ground) on the cylinder 2 exhaust valve deactivation solenoid circuit. The system disables further cylinder deactivation requests until the circuit is repaired.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P3416.title: Cylinder 2 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit High
P3416.description: The engine control module has detected a high-side voltage fault (short to power) on the cylinder 2 exhaust valve deactivation solenoid circuit. Cylinder deactivation is disabled while the fault is present.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P3417.title: Cylinder 3 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit/Open

P3419.title: Cylinder 3 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit Low

P341A.description: The intake valve deactivation system on bank 1 is electrically active but the mechanical response does not match commanded state. Often hydraulic pin sticking from sludge or low oil pressure.

P341B.title: Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit Performance Bank 2

P341C.title: Deactivation/Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Performance Bank 1

P341D.title: Deactivation/Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Performance Bank 2

P3453.title: Cylinder 5 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Low
P3453.description: The engine control module has detected a low voltage condition in the control circuit of the cylinder 5 exhaust valve deactivation solenoid. A short to ground or low-side driver fault prevents proper actuation of the exhaust valve during cylinder deactivation events on bank-relevant cylinder 5.

causes.label: Solenoid or wiring shorted to ground

P3454.title: Cylinder 6 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Low
P3454.description: The engine control module has detected a low voltage condition in the control circuit of the cylinder 6 exhaust valve deactivation solenoid. A short to ground or low-side driver fault prevents proper actuation of the exhaust valve during cylinder deactivation events on cylinder 6.

causes.label: Solenoid or wiring shorted to ground

P3455.title: Cylinder 7 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Low
P3455.description: The engine control module has detected a low voltage condition in the control circuit of the cylinder 7 exhaust valve deactivation solenoid. A short to ground or low-side driver fault prevents proper actuation of the exhaust valve during cylinder deactivation events on cylinder 7.

P3456.title: Cylinder 8 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit/Open
P3456.description: The engine control module has detected an open or out-of-range circuit at the cylinder 8 deactivation or intake valve control solenoid. Cylinder 8 cannot be deactivated until the circuit is restored.

causes.label: Pin pushed back out of connector body

P3457.title: Cylinder 7 Deactivation
P3457.description: The engine control module has detected a fault in the cylinder 7 deactivation system. Cylinder 7 cannot reliably switch between active and deactivated state.

P3458.title: Cylinder 8 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit Low
P3458.description: The engine control module has detected a low-side voltage fault (short to ground) on the cylinder 8 deactivation or intake valve solenoid circuit. Cylinder deactivation is disabled while the fault is present.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P3463.title: Cylinder 8 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit High
P3463.description: The engine control module has detected a high-side voltage fault (short to power) on the cylinder 8 exhaust valve deactivation solenoid circuit. Cylinder deactivation is disabled while the fault is present.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P3464.title: Cylinder 8 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit High
P3464.description: The engine control module has detected a high voltage condition in the control circuit of the cylinder 8 exhaust valve deactivation solenoid. A short to voltage or open low-side path causes the driver to read above the expected range, disabling cylinder deactivation requests for cylinder 8.

causes.label: Solenoid or wiring shorted to power

P3465.title: Cylinder 8 Deactivation
P3465.description: The engine control module has detected a fault in the cylinder 8 deactivation system. Common in V8 engines with active fuel management — cylinder 8 cannot reliably switch state.

P3466.title: Cylinder Deactivation Hydraulic Circuit Bank 1 Open
P3466.description: The engine control module has detected an open hydraulic circuit in the cylinder deactivation system on bank 1. The system uses pressurized engine oil routed through dedicated lifters and oil control valves to collapse valves; an open circuit indicates loss of oil flow or a failed pressure switch.

causes.label: Oil passage blocked or sludge buildup

P3467.title: Cylinder Deactivation Hydraulic Circuit Bank 1 Performance
P3467.description: The engine control module has detected a performance fault in the bank 1 hydraulic circuit used for cylinder deactivation. Oil pressure response or timing is outside the expected window during deactivation events, often caused by viscosity issues, internal leaks or worn lifters.

causes.label: Incorrect oil viscosity or aged oil
Internal oil leak in deactivation circuit

P3468.title: Cylinder Deactivation Hydraulic Circuit Bank 1 Low
P3468.description: The engine control module has detected low oil pressure in the bank 1 hydraulic circuit responsible for cylinder deactivation. Below threshold pressure the lifters cannot collapse and the system disables further deactivation requests on bank 1.

P3469.title: Cylinder Deactivation Hydraulic Circuit Bank 1 High
P3469.description: The engine control module has detected an excessively high oil pressure or stuck-on signal in the bank 1 hydraulic circuit for cylinder deactivation. Either a stuck oil control valve, a blocked relief path, or a shorted pressure switch is reporting permanently high pressure.

P3470.title: Cylinder Deactivation Hydraulic Circuit Bank 2 Open
P3470.description: The engine control module has detected an open hydraulic circuit in the cylinder deactivation system on bank 2. Loss of oil flow, a failed oil pressure switch or a disconnected oil control valve prevents the system from deactivating cylinders on bank 2.

causes.label: Oil passage blocked or sludge buildup

P3471.title: Cylinder Deactivation Hydraulic Circuit Bank 2 Performance
P3471.description: The engine control module has detected a performance fault in the bank 2 hydraulic circuit used for cylinder deactivation. Oil pressure response or actuation timing falls outside the expected window during deactivation events on bank 2, often caused by viscosity issues, internal leaks or worn switching lifters.

causes.label: Incorrect oil viscosity or aged oil
Internal oil leak in deactivation circuit

P3472.title: Cylinder Deactivation Hydraulic Circuit Bank 2 Low
P3472.description: The engine control module has detected low oil pressure in the bank 2 hydraulic circuit responsible for cylinder deactivation. Below the calibrated threshold the switching lifters cannot collapse and cylinder deactivation on bank 2 is disabled until pressure recovers.

P3473.title: Cylinder 9 Deactivation
P3473.description: The engine control module has detected a fault in the cylinder 9 deactivation system. Found on V10/V12 engines with cylinder deactivation — cylinder 9 cannot reliably switch state.

P3474.title: Cylinder Deactivation Hydraulic Circuit Bank 2 High
P3474.description: The engine control module has detected an excessively high oil pressure or stuck-on signal in the bank 2 hydraulic circuit for cylinder deactivation. A stuck oil control valve, a blocked relief path or a shorted pressure switch is reporting permanently high pressure on bank 2.

P3475.title: Cylinder Deactivation Oil Pressure Switch Bank 1 Circuit
P3475.description: The engine control module has detected an electrical fault in the cylinder deactivation oil pressure switch circuit on bank 1. The switch confirms that hydraulic pressure has reached the level required to collapse the switching lifters; without a valid signal the system disables deactivation.

P3476.title: Cylinder Deactivation Oil Pressure Switch Bank 1 Performance
P3476.description: The engine control module has detected a rationality fault between commanded oil pressure and the bank 1 cylinder deactivation oil pressure switch state. The switch fails to change state at the expected pressure threshold during deactivation transitions.

causes.label: Oil control valve slow to respond

P3477.title: Cylinder Deactivation Oil Pressure Switch Bank 2 Circuit
P3477.description: The engine control module has detected an electrical fault in the cylinder deactivation oil pressure switch circuit on bank 2. Without a valid signal the module cannot confirm that hydraulic pressure has reached the level needed to deactivate cylinders on bank 2.

P3478.title: Cylinder Deactivation Oil Pressure Switch Bank 2 Performance
P3478.description: The engine control module has detected a rationality fault between commanded oil pressure and the bank 2 cylinder deactivation oil pressure switch state. The switch fails to change state at the expected pressure threshold during deactivation transitions on bank 2.

causes.label: Oil control valve slow to respond

P3479.title: Cylinder Deactivation Solenoid Bank 1 Control Circuit Open
P3479.description: The engine control module has detected an open circuit at the bank 1 cylinder deactivation solenoid. The solenoid routes oil pressure to the switching lifters; an open circuit prevents activation and the system disables deactivation requests on bank 1.

P3480.title: Cylinder Deactivation Solenoid Bank 2 Control Circuit Open
P3480.description: The engine control module has detected an open circuit at the bank 2 cylinder deactivation solenoid. The solenoid routes oil pressure to the switching lifters on bank 2; an open circuit prevents activation and the system disables deactivation requests on bank 2.

P3481.title: Cylinder 10 Deactivation
P3481.description: The engine control module has detected a fault in the cylinder 10 deactivation system. Found on V10/V12 engines — cylinder 10 cannot reliably switch state.

P3482.title: Cylinder Deactivation Solenoid Bank 1 Control Circuit Low
P3482.description: The engine control module has detected a low voltage condition at the bank 1 cylinder deactivation solenoid control circuit. A short to ground or low-side driver fault prevents proper actuation of the bank 1 deactivation hydraulic path.

causes.label: Solenoid or wiring shorted to ground

P3483.title: Cylinder Deactivation Solenoid Bank 1 Control Circuit High
P3483.description: The engine control module has detected a high voltage condition at the bank 1 cylinder deactivation solenoid control circuit. A short to power or open low-side path causes the driver to read above the expected range, disabling deactivation requests on bank 1.

causes.label: Solenoid or wiring shorted to power

P3484.title: Cylinder Deactivation Solenoid Bank 2 Control Circuit Low
P3484.description: The engine control module has detected a low voltage condition at the bank 2 cylinder deactivation solenoid control circuit. A short to ground or low-side driver fault prevents proper actuation of the bank 2 deactivation hydraulic path.

causes.label: Solenoid or wiring shorted to ground

P3485.title: Cylinder Deactivation Solenoid Bank 2 Control Circuit High
P3485.description: The engine control module has detected a high voltage condition at the bank 2 cylinder deactivation solenoid control circuit. A short to power or open low-side path causes the driver to read above the expected range, disabling deactivation requests on bank 2.

causes.label: Solenoid or wiring shorted to power

P3486.title: Cylinder 11 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Performance
P3486.description: Per-cylinder exhaust valve control on cylinder 11 does not respond as commanded. Mechanical issue at the deactivation actuator for that cylinder.

P3487.title: Cylinder 11 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Low
P3487.description: Cylinder 11 exhaust valve control voltage below expected range — short to ground. The exhaust control valve modulates exhaust backpressure or routing (EGR feed, sound, regen support); a malfunction shifts torque mapping and may trigger limp mode.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P3488.title: Cylinder 11 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit High
P3488.description: Cylinder 11 exhaust valve control voltage above expected range — short to power or open ground. The exhaust control valve modulates exhaust backpressure or routing (EGR feed, sound, regen support); a malfunction shifts torque mapping and may trigger limp mode.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance
Supply wire pinched against B+ source

P3489.title: Cylinder 11 Deactivation
P3489.description: The engine control module has detected a fault in the cylinder 11 deactivation system. Found on V12 engines with cylinder deactivation.

P3490.title: Cylinder Deactivation System Performance Bank 1
P3490.description: The engine control module has detected that the cylinder deactivation system on bank 1 is not performing as expected. Closed-loop monitoring of pressure response, valve timing or misfire counters during transitions indicates the system fails to deactivate or reactivate cylinders within calibrated limits.

P3491.title: Cylinder Deactivation System Performance Bank 2
P3491.description: The engine control module has detected that the cylinder deactivation system on bank 2 is not performing as expected. Closed-loop monitoring of pressure response, valve timing or misfire counters during transitions indicates the system fails to deactivate or reactivate cylinders within calibrated limits.

P3492.title: Cylinder Deactivation Position Sensor Bank 1
P3492.description: The engine control module has detected an implausible signal from the bank 1 cylinder deactivation position sensor. Modern systems use a Hall-effect or inductive sensor to confirm switching lifter position; a fault prevents safe deactivation transitions.

P3493.title: Cylinder Deactivation Position Sensor Bank 2
P3493.description: The engine control module has detected an implausible signal from the bank 2 cylinder deactivation position sensor. The sensor confirms switching lifter position; without a valid signal the module cannot safely command deactivation transitions on bank 2.

P3494.title: Cylinder Deactivation Position Sensor Bank 1 Range/Performance
P3494.description: The engine control module has detected the bank 1 cylinder deactivation position sensor signal is within electrical limits but does not change as expected during commanded deactivation transitions. Mechanical drag, sensor drift or contamination is the typical cause.

P3495.title: Cylinder Deactivation Position Sensor Bank 2 Range/Performance
P3495.description: The engine control module has detected the bank 2 cylinder deactivation position sensor signal is within electrical limits but does not change as expected during commanded deactivation transitions. Mechanical drag, sensor drift or contamination is the typical cause.

P3496.title: Cylinder 12 Deactivation
P3496.description: The engine control module has detected a fault in the cylinder 12 deactivation system. Found on V12 engines with cylinder deactivation.

P3497.title: Cylinder Deactivation System Bank 2
P3497.description: The engine control module has detected a fault in the cylinder deactivation system on bank 2. Same as P3400 but for the second cylinder bank in V-engines.

causes.label: Deactivation solenoid or oil control valve failed

P3498.title: Cylinder Deactivation Pressure Sensor Bank 1
P3498.description: The engine control module has detected a fault with the bank 1 cylinder deactivation pressure sensor. Newer variable displacement systems use an analogue oil pressure sensor in addition to or in place of the legacy switch; a fault disables closed-loop deactivation control on bank 1.

P3499.title: Cylinder Deactivation Pressure Sensor Bank 2
P3499.description: The engine control module has detected a fault with the bank 2 cylinder deactivation pressure sensor. The analogue oil pressure sensor is used to verify the deactivation hydraulic state; a fault disables closed-loop deactivation control on bank 2.

P34A6.title: A Camshaft Position Actuator Temperature Sensor Circuit Low Bank 1
